hook.name: MeridianHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Meridian launchpad token pools, holding the entire token supply in a single hook-owned position. Charges fixed-rate fees on exact-input swaps — deducted from buy inputs via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and from sell outputs via afterSwapReturnsDelta — splitting proceeds between protocol and creator. Swaps are temporally gated per pool via a tradingStartsAt timestamp.
